brief:
Israeli occupation forces are continuing to bulldoze Palestinian-owned land in the western area of Deir Ballut, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolition operations are ongoing in the region, which has seen repeated encroachments on civilian property.

The scale of the current operations and the number of landowners affected remain unclear. Israeli authorities have not issued a public statement regarding the justification for the bulldozing campaign or its intended scope. Residents in the area have faced recurring challenges to their land tenure as military operations in the West Bank persist.
title: Israeli forces bulldoze Palestinian land west of Deir Ballut
